---
title: "Overall survival — primary estimand"
subtitle: "182-day RMST, survival, and risk contrasts pooled over 50 imputations"
format: html
execute:
  freeze: false
---

For each imputation, 200 deterministic standardized posterior survival draws
are generated on 200 equally spaced time points through day 182. RMST uses the
trapezoidal rule. Imputation branches are pooled with equal weight only after
all 50 branches have completed.

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
source(here::here("R", "analysis-config.R"))
source(here::here("R", "paths-artifacts.R"))
source(here::here("R", "checkpoints.R"))
source(here::here("R", "model-helpers.R"))
source(here::here("R", "imputation.R"))
source(here::here("R", "survival-helpers.R"))
source(here::here("analysis", "module-runtime.R"))

runtime <- module_runtime()
config <- runtime$config
indices <- module_exact_indices(config)
model_dir <- project_path("artifacts", "primary", "overall-survival", "models")
data_dir <- project_path("artifacts", "primary", "overall-survival", "imputations")
draw_dir <- ensure_directory(project_path("artifacts", "primary", "overall-survival", "estimand"))
result_dir <- ensure_directory(project_path("results", "primary", "overall-survival"))
code_paths <- module_code_paths(
  here::here("R", "analysis-config.R"), here::here("R", "imputation.R"),
  here::here("R", "model-helpers.R"), here::here("R", "survival-helpers.R"),
  here::here("R", "checkpoints.R"), here::here("analysis", "module-runtime.R"),
  knitr::current_input()
)
```

```{r}
#| label: derive-os-branches
#| include: false
for (index in indices) {
  model_path <- file.path(model_dir, sprintf("model-%02d.rds", index))
  data_path <- file.path(data_dir, sprintf("imputation-%02d.parquet", index))
  curves_path <- file.path(draw_dir, sprintf("survival-curves-%02d.parquet", index))
  rmst_path <- file.path(draw_dir, sprintf("rmst-draws-%02d.parquet", index))
  risk_path <- file.path(draw_dir, sprintf("risk-draws-%02d.parquet", index))
  if (!file.exists(model_path) || !file.exists(data_path)) {
    stop("OS estimand inputs are incomplete for imputation ", index, ".")
  }
  module_branch(
    runtime = runtime,
    stage_id = sprintf("primary-os-estimand-%02d", index),
    input_paths = c(model_path, data_path),
    output_paths = c(curves_path, rmst_path, risk_path),
    code_paths = code_paths,
    metadata = list(endpoint = "overall_survival", imputation = index,
                   posterior_draws = 200L, standardized_time_points = 200L),
    worker = function() {
      model <- readRDS(model_path)
      data <- module_read_parquet(data_path)
      standardized_curve <- function(treatment, seed) {
        newdata <- data
        newdata$tx <- treatment
        old_exists <- exists(".Random.seed", envir = .GlobalEnv, inherits = FALSE)
        old_seed <- if (old_exists) get(".Random.seed", envir = .GlobalEnv) else NULL
        set.seed(seed)
        raw <- tryCatch(
          rstanarm::posterior_survfit(
            model,
            newdata = newdata,
            times = 0,
            extrapolate = TRUE,
            standardise = TRUE,
            control = list(edist = as.numeric(config$analysis$horizon_days), epoints = 200L),
            return_matrix = TRUE,
            draws = 200L
          ),
          finally = {
            if (old_exists) assign(".Random.seed", old_seed, envir = .GlobalEnv)
            else if (exists(".Random.seed", envir = .GlobalEnv, inherits = FALSE)) {
              rm(".Random.seed", envir = .GlobalEnv)
            }
          }
        )
        matrix_value <- if (is.matrix(raw)) raw else {
          if (!is.list(raw) || length(raw) == 0L) stop("posterior_survfit returned no standardized curves.")
          do.call(cbind, raw)
        }
        matrix_value <- as.matrix(matrix_value)
        times <- attr(raw, "times")
        if (is.null(times) && is.list(raw)) times <- attr(raw[[1L]], "times")
        if (is.null(times)) {
          times <- seq(0, as.numeric(config$analysis$horizon_days), length.out = ncol(matrix_value))
        }
        times <- as.numeric(times)
        if (length(times) != ncol(matrix_value)) stop("Standardized survival times do not match posterior draws.")
        if (nrow(matrix_value) < 200L && ncol(matrix_value) == 200L) matrix_value <- t(matrix_value)
        if (nrow(matrix_value) < 200L) stop("posterior_survfit returned fewer than 200 draws.")
        matrix_value <- matrix_value[seq_len(200L), , drop = FALSE]
        data.frame(
          draw = rep(seq_len(200L), each = length(times)),
          time = rep(times, times = 200L),
          survival = as.vector(t(matrix_value)),
          tx = treatment,
          stringsAsFactors = FALSE
        )
      }
      curves <- rbind(
        standardized_curve(0, analysis_seed(config, "survival", index, offset = 0L)),
        standardized_curve(1, analysis_seed(config, "survival", index, offset = 1000L))
      )
      curves$imputation <- index
      rmst <- compute_rmst_draws(
        curves,
        draw_col = "draw",
        time_col = "time",
        survival_col = "survival",
        horizon = as.numeric(config$analysis$horizon_days),
        group_cols = c("tx", "imputation")
      )
      risk <- survival_risk_draws(
        curves,
        horizon = as.numeric(config$analysis$horizon_days),
        treatment_col = "tx"
      )
      risk$imputation <- index
      module_save_parquet(curves, curves_path)
      module_save_parquet(rmst, rmst_path)
      module_save_parquet(risk, risk_path)
    }
  )
}
```

```{r}
#| label: pool-os-estimand
#| include: false
pooled_outputs <- c(
  project_path("results", "primary", "overall-survival", "rmst-summary.parquet"),
  project_path("results", "primary", "overall-survival", "risk-summary.parquet"),
  project_path("results", "primary", "overall-survival", "estimand-draws.parquet"),
  project_path("results", "primary", "overall-survival", "survival-curves.parquet"),
  project_path("results", "primary", "overall-survival", "follow-up-sufficiency.yml")
)
branch_inputs <- c(
  file.path(draw_dir, sprintf("rmst-draws-%02d.parquet", indices)),
  file.path(draw_dir, sprintf("risk-draws-%02d.parquet", indices)),
  file.path(draw_dir, sprintf("survival-curves-%02d.parquet", indices))
)
module_branch(
  runtime = runtime,
  stage_id = "primary-os-estimand-pooling",
  input_paths = branch_inputs,
  output_paths = pooled_outputs,
  code_paths = code_paths,
  metadata = list(endpoint = "overall_survival", imputations = 50L,
                 posterior_draws_per_imputation = 200L, rope_days = c(-7, 7)),
  worker = function() {
    rmst_frames <- lapply(indices, function(index) {
      frame <- module_read_parquet(file.path(draw_dir, sprintf("rmst-draws-%02d.parquet", index)))
      frame$imputation <- index
      frame
    })
    rmst_frames <- lapply(rmst_frames, function(frame) {
      control <- frame[frame$tx == 0, c("draw", "imputation", "rmst"), drop = FALSE]
      intervention <- frame[frame$tx == 1, c("draw", "imputation", "rmst"), drop = FALSE]
      names(control)[names(control) == "rmst"] <- "rmst_0"
      names(intervention)[names(intervention) == "rmst"] <- "rmst_1"
      joined <- merge(control, intervention, by = c("draw", "imputation"), all = FALSE)
      joined$rmst_diff <- joined$rmst_1 - joined$rmst_0
      joined
    })
    if (length(rmst_frames) != 50L) stop("RMST pooling requires all 50 imputations.")
    pooled_rmst <- pool_equal_weight_draws(
      lapply(rmst_frames, function(frame) frame["rmst_diff"]),
      n_draws = 200L,
      seed = analysis_seed(config, "reports")
    )
    pooled_rmst$draw <- pooled_rmst$.pooled_draw
    summary <- summarize_posterior_draws(pooled_rmst$rmst_diff)
    summary$probability_benefit <- posterior_probability(pooled_rmst$rmst_diff)
    summary$ci_66_low <- stats::quantile(pooled_rmst$rmst_diff, 0.17, names = FALSE)
    summary$ci_66_high <- stats::quantile(pooled_rmst$rmst_diff, 0.83, names = FALSE)
    summary$ci_95_low <- stats::quantile(pooled_rmst$rmst_diff, 0.025, names = FALSE)
    summary$ci_95_high <- stats::quantile(pooled_rmst$rmst_diff, 0.975, names = FALSE)
    summary$rope_low <- -7
    summary$rope_high <- 7
    summary$rope_66_contains <- summary$ci_66_low >= -7 && summary$ci_66_high <= 7
    summary$horizon_days <- 182L
    risk_frames <- lapply(indices, function(index) {
      frame <- module_read_parquet(file.path(draw_dir, sprintf("risk-draws-%02d.parquet", index)))
      frame$imputation <- index
      frame
    })
    pooled_risks <- pool_equal_weight_draws(risk_frames, n_draws = 200L,
                                            seed = analysis_seed(config, "reports", offset = 1L))
    risk_summary <- summarize_survival_risks(pooled_risks)
    risk_table <- data.frame(
      measure = c("survival_risk_difference", "survival_risk_ratio"),
      mean = c(risk_summary$summary["risk_difference", "mean"], risk_summary$summary["risk_ratio", "mean"]),
      median = c(risk_summary$summary["risk_difference", "median"], risk_summary$summary["risk_ratio", "median"]),
      q025 = c(risk_summary$summary["risk_difference", "q2.5"], risk_summary$summary["risk_ratio", "q2.5"]),
      q975 = c(risk_summary$summary["risk_difference", "q97.5"], risk_summary$summary["risk_ratio", "q97.5"]),
      horizon_days = 182L,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
    curve_frames <- lapply(indices, function(index) {
      frame <- module_read_parquet(file.path(draw_dir, sprintf("survival-curves-%02d.parquet", index)))
      frame$imputation <- index
      frame
    })
    pooled_curves <- do.call(rbind, curve_frames)
    if (!is.data.frame(pooled_curves) || nrow(pooled_curves) == 0L) {
      stop("OS survival-curve pooling produced no rows.")
    }
    max_curve_day <- max(pooled_curves$time, na.rm = TRUE)
    sufficiency <- data.frame(
      horizon_days = c(182L, 365L),
      sufficient = c(max_curve_day >= 182, max_curve_day >= 365),
      reason = c(
        if (max_curve_day >= 182) "Primary OS curves cover the 182-day horizon."
        else "Primary OS curves do not cover the 182-day horizon.",
        if (max_curve_day >= 365) "OS curves cover the 365-day horizon."
        else "The locked primary OS curves stop at 182 days."
      ),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
    module_save_parquet(as.data.frame(summary), pooled_outputs[1L])
    module_save_parquet(risk_table, pooled_outputs[2L])
    module_save_parquet(pooled_rmst, pooled_outputs[3L])
    module_save_parquet(pooled_curves, pooled_outputs[4L])
    write_atomic_text(yaml::as.yaml(sufficiency), pooled_outputs[5L])
  }
)
```
